comp170.name: COMP 170 Introduction to Programming with Python
comp170.description: An introductory college programming course covering Python fundamentals: variables, control flow, functions, basic data structures, and simple program design. Assume a novice audience.

comp271.name: COMP 271 Linear Data Structures
comp271.description: A sophomore-level course on linear data structures (arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues) and their implementation and analysis, typically in Java or C++.

comp363.name: COMP 363 Design and Analysis of Algorithms
comp363.description: An upper-level course on algorithm design and analysis: asymptotic complexity, divide-and-conquer, dynamic programming, greedy algorithms, and graph algorithms.
